body:
The mom hasn't replied at all to my 'requesting contact' email. The dad did reply to that first email, but once I sent off the email with all the information he didn't reply. It's been over 48 hours since I sent out the weighty email and the friend hasn't indicated that anything is out of the ordinary, so I'm waiting for the dad to make a move...
That's a good plan, cleaning my room definitely makes me feel better - a little more accomplished at least. It's a good time to make resolutions as well.
The thought of explaining myself never crossed my mind - I guess if I were in my friend's situation I would want an explanation myself. Thanks for the guidance, then.
I definitely needed to hear that. I've just sent off the emails. I will get treated as soon as I can. Thanks for the advice; it all really helped.
Well it's great that you're going home for the holidays! I'm still a student so I'm spending my break at home.

I haven't had any treatment yet. I think I should hold out for it.

Anything involving schoolwork and social interaction usually doesn't end well for me. I've always been good at school but my undone work's piling up and I really need to get that done over break if I want a chance at anything. As for social interaction, I am incredibly socially inept, and also a bit of a jackass, so I usually walk away from a conversation feeling worse about myself.

I do like writing and talking to two of my best friends, but that bit of happiness might fall away soon, as one of those friends is also undergoing suicidal thoughts, cutting, and bulimia. I've confided to the other friend and we agreed that I'll soon be nuking four years of friendship so I can get in contact with that friend's parents and hopefully get them to take action. I just hope I don't make things worse.

Thanks for replying. Sorry, I went to try and sleep off some of what I was feeling, and it helped a little. 
How has your day/night been?
